component.name: WLED Ambilight
component.summary: Send the colours of your screen to your LEDs
Bildschirmfarben an die LEDs im Raum senden

description.p: WLED Ambilight captures your screen, averages freely placed zones and streams the colours in real time to WLED strips, PC peripherals, Govee lights and Nanoleaf panels – the glow behind your monitor follows the picture.

WLED Ambilight nimmt den Bildschirm auf, mittelt frei platzierbare Zonen und schickt die Farben in Echtzeit an WLED-Streifen, PC-Peripherie, Govee-Leuchten und Nanoleaf-Panels – das Licht hinter dem Monitor folgt dem Bild.

ul.li: Drives WLED, OpenRGB (PC peripherals), Razer Chroma, Govee and Nanoleaf – no account, no cloud
Finds devices on the network automatically
Zones are placed and resized with the mouse, independent of resolution
Any number of LEDs per device via DDP, DRGB for older firmware
Temporal and spatial smoothing, median filter, brightness, gamma and saturation
Per-device frame rate limit, reversed strips and BGR clones
Runs in the tray or headless for autostart

screenshot.caption: Zones on the screen preview with the light they produce

description.p: First public release: Linux, Windows and macOS.
